title: 第十三个房客
blurb_en: Under the floorboards of a cheap Shanghai room is a diary. The last line, written three days ago, says not to drink the landlady's tea. The landlady makes tea every evening.
blurb_zh: 便宜的出租屋地板下面，有一本日记。最后一页写着：不要喝房东的茶。房东每天晚上都给她泡茶。
